rationale: Parabacteroides johnsonii is a saccharolytic Bacteroidetes that ferments glucose and lactate to mixed short-chain fatty acids under anaerobic conditions. Uptake of glucose and lactate as primary substrates with arginine and cysteine for nitrogen and growth factors. Fermentation products (acetate, propionate, succinate) regenerate NAD+ and balance redox. Growth rate of 0.39 /h is realistic for anaerobic batch culture with abundant substrates.
